cards.gloss_en: telling or recounting a story or events
cards.ex_en: She is relating the story of her trip.
cards.ex_cn: 她正在讲述她旅行的故事。

cards.gloss_en: a serious, solemn quality or state of mind
cards.ex_en: He spoke with great seriousness.

cards.gloss_en: in a kind and merciful way
cards.ex_en: God mercifully saved the sailors.
cards.ex_cn: 上帝仁慈地救了水手们。

cards.gloss_en: the hard outer covering of an egg
cards.ex_en: The egg has a hard shell.

cards.gloss_en: old form of do used with thou
cards.ex_en: What dost thou want?

cards.gloss_en: old word for yourself
cards.ex_en: Know thyself well.

cards.gloss_en: old form of were used with thou
cards.ex_en: Thou wert my friend.

cards.gloss_en: to give praise and honour to someone
cards.ex_en: The people glorify their king.

cards.gloss_en: to carry out or make a promise come true
cards.ex_en: He tried to fulfil his promise.

cards.gloss_en: raised to a high rank, noble and lofty
cards.ex_en: He held an exalted position.

cards.gloss_en: roused oneself into active effort
cards.ex_en: He bestirred himself to work.

cards.gloss_en: wide flat grassy plains
cards.ex_en: Lions live on the savannahs.
cards.ex_cn: 狮子生活在热带草原上。

cards.gloss_en: growing well and thriving
cards.ex_en: The garden is flourishing.

cards.gloss_en: a valley
cards.ex_en: A river runs through the vale.

cards.gloss_en: property or possessions passed down to an heir
cards.ex_en: He spent all his inheritance.

cards.gloss_en: a large country house with its land
cards.ex_en: They live in an old manor.
cards.ex_cn: 他们住在一座古老的庄园里。

cards.gloss_en: past tense of tread; stepped on
cards.ex_en: He trod on my foot by mistake.

cards.gloss_en: the quality of being pleasant and agreeable
cards.ex_en: I enjoyed the pleasantness of the day.

cards.gloss_en: small branches and low undergrowth
cards.ex_en: We gathered brushwood for the fire.

cards.gloss_en: clusters of things growing or held together
cards.ex_en: She bought two bunches of grapes.

cards.gloss_en: harmful animals or pests
cards.ex_en: Rats are seen as vermin.

cards.gloss_en: meat and vegetables cooked slowly in liquid
cards.ex_en: We had a hot stew for dinner.

cards.gloss_en: admitting or recognizing something to be true
cards.ex_en: He is acknowledging his mistake.
cards.ex_cn: 他正在承认自己的错误。

cards.gloss_en: morally good and just
cards.ex_en: He is a righteous man.

cards.gloss_en: renewed strength and energy after rest
cards.ex_en: A short rest gave me refreshment.
cards.ex_cn: 短暂的休息让我恢复了精神。

cards.gloss_en: a short written note to help remember
cards.ex_en: She wrote a memorandum for the meeting.
cards.ex_cn: 她为会议写了一份备忘录。

cards.gloss_en: a metal pot for boiling water
cards.ex_en: Put the kettle on the fire.

cards.gloss_en: a wide flat grassy plain
cards.ex_en: The savannah was full of grass.

cards.gloss_en: in a friendly, intimate way
cards.ex_en: He spoke to me familiarly.

cards.gloss_en: extreme hardships or dire situations
cards.ex_en: They suffered great extremities at sea.
cards.ex_cn: 他们在海上遭遇了极大的困境。

cards.gloss_en: caused something to be in a certain state
cards.ex_en: The rain rendered the road unsafe.
cards.ex_cn: 大雨使道路变得不安全。

cards.gloss_en: giving comfort and easing worry
cards.ex_en: Her words were very comforting.

cards.gloss_en: hateful or under a curse
cards.ex_en: They fled the cursed house.
cards.ex_cn: 他们逃离了那座被诅咒的房子。

cards.gloss_en: extremely bad and hateful
cards.ex_en: The smell was abominable.

cards.gloss_en: calmness and control of one's feelings
cards.ex_en: She kept her composure in danger.

cards.gloss_en: a release of strong emotion
cards.ex_en: He gave vent to his anger.

cards.gloss_en: chopping or cutting with heavy blows
cards.ex_en: The man was hewing wood all morning.
cards.ex_cn: 那人整个上午都在劈柴。

cards.gloss_en: hard and tiring work
cards.ex_en: After years of toil, he succeeded.
cards.ex_cn: 经过多年辛劳,他成功了。

cards.gloss_en: a shaped mass of baked bread
cards.ex_en: She bought a loaf of bread.

cards.gloss_en: short curved swords once used by sailors
cards.ex_en: The sailors carried cutlasses.

cards.gloss_en: to make use of something for a purpose
cards.ex_en: We employ this tool to dig.
cards.ex_cn: 我们用这个工具来挖土。

cards.gloss_en: a very large number of things or people
cards.ex_en: A multitude of people came.

cards.gloss_en: a loss of confidence or hope
cards.ex_en: He felt deep discouragement.

cards.gloss_en: overcame or defeated
cards.ex_en: She conquered her fear at last.

cards.gloss_en: a farm tool for breaking up soil
cards.ex_en: The farmer pulled a harrow over the field.

cards.gloss_en: tools with a mesh for sifting
cards.ex_en: We need sieves to sift the flour.
cards.ex_cn: 我们需要筛子来筛面粉。

suspect.ctx: reading the Scripture, I came to ... “Him hath God exalted with His right hand to be a Prince and a Saviour”
suspect.issue: 书里 exalted 是动词过去分词(God exalted him=上帝把他高举/提升到尊位),现释义给的是形容词“崇高的、高贵的”,回读“上帝崇高的他”不通
suspect.suggest: 增补动词义:抬高、高举、擢升(至尊位)
